name: spot
moment: READ: a marked condition lights up under the crosshair for the first time (a discovery)
prompt: A small metal flashlight switch clicked on, one crisp click

name: open
moment: READ: look closer, the inspection sheet opens
prompt: A clipboard picked up and its top paper page flipped over, paper and hardboard, close up

name: tick
prompt: A ballpoint pen ticking a box firmly on a paper form, one quick scratch

name: right
moment: REVEAL right: the call matches the site, the area is safe as handled
prompt: A heavy steel padlock shackle clicked shut, then a key turned and pulled out of the lock with a short jingle of a key ring

name: wrong
moment: REVEAL wrong: the call does not match the site
prompt: Cardboard boxes toppling off a pallet and thudding onto a concrete floor

name: signoff
moment: end: the walk is finished and the report appears
prompt: A pen signature scribbled quickly on paper, then the sheet torn off a notepad

name: sting-victory
moment: END OF RUN, passed: the engine pass result is known (audio.finish victory; the bed fades first)
note: Installed by tools/audio/install-stings.sh from engines/rpg/assets/music/LISTEN/engines/<id>/sting-victory.mp3. Not generated: swap the LISTEN file and re-run the script.
